changelog: Shared craft-common base: new optional argBase64Keys, jsonTextKeys and previewTools options (for DesignCraft); no change in this plugin's tools.
name: FigCraft
description: Headless interface design tool (FigCraft from ArtCraft, open source, written in Rust). Designs app and web screens with frames, auto layout, shapes, text, components, styles, variables and prototype links; opens FigCraft projects, .fig and .sketch files (best effort), SVG and images; exports PNG, JPEG, WebP, SVG and PDF and saves .figcraft projects.
instructions:
FigCraft runs headless in your own container; every file lives in /work.

1. Start a new design right away, or upload the user's file to /work and open it: open_file {"path":"/work/design.fig"} reads .figcraft, FigCraft/REST API .json, .fig and .sketch (best effort: tell the user about the `warnings` it returns), .svg (becomes vectors) and images (become an image layer).
2. Build with create_node: a frame is a screen, e.g. create_node {"type":"frame","name":"Login","width":390,"height":844,"props":{"fill":"#FFFFFF","layout":"vertical","gap":16,"padding":24}} returns its id. Put layers inside it with "parent": text {"type":"text","parent":2,"text":"Sign in","props":{"fontSize":28}}, inputs and buttons as rectangles with {"cornerRadius":8} and a fill. Change layers with set_properties {"ids":[3],"props":{"characters":"Log in","fill":"#3366FF"}}.
3. Everything else (align, components and instances, styles, variables, prototype links, boolean operations…) is an engine command: list_commands {"filter":"component"} — always pass a filter, never list all — then run_command {"command":...,"params":{...}}, or batch for several commands as one undo step. Undo with undo.
4. Check the result: inspect_document shows the layer tree; screenshot {"ids":[2]} saves a PNG into /work and returns its path (no inline image) — download it to look at it.
5. Export always with a path in /work: export {"ids":[2],"path":"/work/login.png","scale":2}; the same with .svg, .pdf, .jpg or .webp. Save the project with save_file {"path":"/work/<name>.figcraft"}; use new file names, never overwrite the user's input.
6. Hand the result over: download it from /work with plugin_download_file.

All paths must be inside /work; relative paths resolve against /work. A new MCP session (e.g. after a reconnect) starts with no open document, so save the .figcraft project after each stage and reopen it then. The container and /work are deleted after the conversation is idle, so always download the results.

accepts.description: FigCraft project to edit or export
Figma file to import (best effort, with warnings)
Sketch file to import (Sketch 48 or newer, best effort)
FigCraft document or REST API file JSON
PNG image to place as an image layer
JPEG image to place as an image layer

returns.description: Exported screen or layer, or a screenshot
Exported screen or layer as JPEG
Exported screen or layer as WebP
